liveEvidencePolicy: Paths are mandatory release-evidence destinations; listing a path does not claim that staging, screenshot, soak, canary or rehearsal evidence has already been collected.

rows.requirement: Additive schema and concurrent lazy ensure
rows.positiveCase: first open and concurrent open create all Knowledge tables without user_version change
rows.deniedCase: older reader does not require Knowledge tables
rows.failureOrRestartCase: candidate reopen and partial additive-column upgrade

rows.positiveCase: create and update with current revision
rows.deniedCase: User audience cannot create/archive Zone
rows.failureOrRestartCase: stale revision returns STALE_REVISION

rows.positiveCase: Administrator creates and assigns; Curator creates a draft Source
rows.deniedCase: wrong audience, Viewer mutation, Manager Agent binding, Curator publish and foreign Zone access are denied
rows.failureOrRestartCase: same Idempotency-Key replays the exact successful create response

rows.positiveCase: Manager replaces Viewer and Curator
rows.deniedCase: Manager cannot add or remove Manager
rows.failureOrRestartCase: concurrent member edit is revision-rejected

rows.positiveCase: shared and personal canonical resource keys bind
rows.deniedCase: Manager and Curator cannot bind
rows.failureOrRestartCase: unbind increments access revision

rows.positiveCase: 4 MiB chunks resume at exact offset and commit once
rows.deniedCase: wrong owner, oversize, wrong offset, invalid filename and quota fail
rows.failureOrRestartCase: claim lease fences concurrent writer; TTL expires staging

rows.surface: create, upload, retry, publish and rollback APIs
rows.positiveCase: same key and body replay exact status and identities
rows.deniedCase: same key with another body returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
rows.failureOrRestartCase: running claim prevents concurrent duplicate execution

rows.positiveCase: typed slug plus current revision permanently removes the dependency graph
rows.deniedCase: active Zone, wrong confirmation, User audience and active jobs/uploads are blocked
rows.failureOrRestartCase: shared CAS blobs remain while another Source Version references the same hash

rows.positiveCase: heading/table/cell, sheet/range/formula and slide/shape locators survive
rows.deniedCase: macro, OLE, external relationship and DTD/XXE are rejected
rows.failureOrRestartCase: malformed or oversized archive becomes permanent parser failure

rows.positiveCase: permitted provider emits OCR locator and provenance
rows.deniedCase: local-only Zone cannot use remote OCR
rows.failureOrRestartCase: missing or failed OCR leaves needs_ocr and publish is blocked

rows.positiveCase: exact page or same-origin depth-two crawl
rows.deniedCase: robots denial, cross-origin link and unsafe IP are not fetched
rows.failureOrRestartCase: redirect and child failure remain bounded and safe

rows.positiveCase: private FTS generation returns exact locator
rows.deniedCase: another Zone index is never opened as a candidate source
rows.failureOrRestartCase: missing or corrupt derived index is rebuildable

rows.positiveCase: FTS/vector RRF, title boost, dedup, diversity and source cap
rows.deniedCase: provider/model/dimension mismatch cannot use vector results
rows.failureOrRestartCase: query embedding failure falls back to FTS with warning

rows.positiveCase: current candidate flips active pointer atomically; verified old publication rolls back
rows.deniedCase: Curator cannot publish; degraded candidate requires reason
rows.failureOrRestartCase: stale source-set and concurrent revision fail before flip

rows.positiveCase: valid User session plus Agent entitlement plus binding searches active publication
rows.deniedCase: membership alone grants no Agent access
rows.failureOrRestartCase: pre-return revision check blocks concurrent revoke

rows.positiveCase: search reference is followed by authorized get
rows.deniedCase: search excerpt is withheld and signed citation tamper fails
rows.failureOrRestartCase: final answer without get requests one revision; zero hit uses fixed fallback

rows.positiveCase: healthy authorized Zones still return results
rows.deniedCase: foreign and unbound Zones are absent
rows.failureOrRestartCase: partial true and unavailable coverage are explicit

rows.positiveCase: exact Source Version and locator open while current access permits
rows.deniedCase: tampered, purged or currently unauthorized citation returns not found
rows.failureOrRestartCase: historical transcript chip survives but click rechecks binding

rows.surface: Knowledge activity API and audit store
rows.positiveCase: success, denial and failure include safe correlation metadata
rows.deniedCase: User audience cannot enumerate global audit
rows.failureOrRestartCase: raw query, chunk, embedding, credential and signed citation are absent

rows.positiveCase: artifact permissions, index checksum/integrity, jobs and search percentiles report without corpus data
rows.deniedCase: User audience cannot call doctor and filesystem paths are absent
rows.failureOrRestartCase: missing artifact and mismatched index checksum are explicit

rows.positiveCase: role-specific states, keyboard, focus, progress and aria-live work
rows.deniedCase: hidden actions remain server-denied by direct request
rows.failureOrRestartCase: offline, reload, stale revision and durable job state are visible

rows.surface: shared DB, artifacts and derived generations
rows.positiveCase: same-epoch DB and artifact restore preserves publication pointers
rows.deniedCase: checksum mismatch cannot be promoted
rows.failureOrRestartCase: derived indexes rebuild with no Source Version mutation

rows.positiveCase: one million chunks and twenty Zones stay within FD/RAM budgets
rows.deniedCase: queue and upload quotas apply pressure
rows.failureOrRestartCase: leases recover after crash at every stage
rows.automatedTest: src/enterprise/knowledge/worker-restart.test.ts; one-million-chunk capacity is a mandatory pre-release environment test

rows.requirement: Shared Markdown graph primitives and artifact v1/v2 compatibility
rows.positiveCase: wikilink, Markdown link, alias and backlink normalization have one canonical implementation and v2 preserves locators
rows.deniedCase: inline-code and fenced-code links are ignored; v1 artifacts are never rewritten
rows.failureOrRestartCase: malformed markup remains plain untrusted content

rows.requirement: Immutable per-Zone graph generation and risk review
rows.surface: generation v2, review and manual-edge APIs
rows.positiveCase: deterministic/semantic/enriched graph retains evidence and review/manual overlays rebuild a new candidate
rows.deniedCase: proposed, rejected, orphan and broken-evidence edges never enter active traversal/export
rows.failureOrRestartCase: stale refs/evidence fingerprints and build revisions fail closed

rows.requirement: Graph HTTP ACL and opaque references
rows.positiveCase: Viewer reads active, Curator reviews candidate, Manager exports, Administrator changes graph policy
rows.deniedCase: Viewer candidate, non-Admin settings, Curator export and foreign/stale refs are denied
rows.failureOrRestartCase: generation change invalidates node and edge references with 404

rows.positiveCase: accepted graph adds evidence behind hybrid seeds while exact get remains mandatory
rows.deniedCase: candidate/rejected edges and chained similar edges cannot expand retrieval
rows.failureOrRestartCase: 1.5-second budget returns hybrid results with partial warning and authority is rechecked before return

rows.positiveCase: Active/Candidate/Compare, filters, inspector, review, manual relation and quick-open work by role
rows.deniedCase: role-hidden controls remain denied by direct HTTP request
rows.failureOrRestartCase: stale requests cancel and WebGL/context loss/reduced motion use synchronized list fallback with renderer cleanup

rows.positiveCase: active accepted graph exports Markdown, wikilinks, backlinks, report, manifest and checksum
rows.deniedCase: raw binary, ACL/account/Agent IDs, credentials, embeddings, signed refs, server paths and plugins are absent
rows.failureOrRestartCase: size cap fails safely; private archive expires and permission is rechecked on download

rows.requirement: Graph staged rollout and reversible operations
rows.surface: feature flags, doctor, canary and rollback
rows.positiveCase: one Zone progresses off to shadow to on with health/capacity evidence
rows.deniedCase: existing Zones are never bulk rebuilt or bulk published
rows.failureOrRestartCase: agentExpansion off and publication rollback preserve FTS/vector/search/get
rows.automatedTest: src/enterprise/knowledge/knowledge-doctor.test.ts, worker restart tests and config tests
